            for (r,c) in o['boundary']:
                if not (rmin<r<rmax and cmin<c<cmax):
                    inside=False
                    break
            if inside:
                interior_objs.append(o)
    print('interior object colors',[o['color'] for o in interior_objs])
    # count g
    print('g count inside', sum(1 for o in interior_objs if o['color']=='g'))
else:
    print('no mag rect')
